title: Business Analyst Internship with full time employment as BA Trainee
company: Bow and Baan Technology Solutions pvt Ltd
description: PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING This opportunity is intended for candidates who are looking for a long-term career in Business Analysis and are willing to commit to a minimum of 2 years of full-time employment after successful completion of the internship. The career progression will be as follows: First 3 Months – Internship: Candidates will undergo structured training and gain practical exposure to Business Analysis and software development projects. Next 1 Year – Business Analyst (Trainee): Upon successful completion of the internship and satisfactory performance, candidates will be offered full-time employment as Business Analyst – Trainee. Please apply only if you are agreeing with this employment structure and commitment. Job Overview We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Business Analyst intern to join our dynamic team. As an intern, you will work closely with stakeholders across the organization and learn to analyze business needs, translating them into actionable requirements, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver effective solutions. The Business Analyst intern will learn and contribute to the success of our projects by leveraging analytical skills, industry knowledge, interpersonal skills and excellent communication abilities. Responsibilities Responsibilities Gather and document business requirements from stakeholders. Translate requirements into functional specifications for development teams. Collaborate with product managers and developers to refine user stories and acceptance criteria. Conduct gap analysis and propose solutions aligned with business goals. Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) and ensure deliverables meet quality standards. Act as liaison between clients and technical teams to ensure clear communication. Create BRDs (Business Requirement Documents), FRDs (Functional Requirement Documents), Prototypes, and process flows. Develop test cases and assist in system integration testing. Work closely with Dev, QA teams to validate solutions against client expectations. Provide ongoing support for change requests and enhancements. Use tools such as SQL, Python, Excel, and BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Opensource tools) to automate data tasks. Write scripts to automate data cleaning, reporting, and other routine analysis tasks. Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, and analytics teams. Participate in team meetings, code reviews, and brainstorming sessions. Document methodologies, findings, and project outcomes clearly and concisely. Stay current on industry trends in AI, data analytics, and machine learning. Take initiative to explore new tools, methods, and AI applications in data analysis. Receive mentorship and training to grow technical and analytical skills. Collaborate with stakeholders to understand needs, objectives, and challenges. MS office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)/ G suite proficiency. Experience in coding will be an added advantage. Candidates, who do not have any software education, please do not apply Apply SDLC methodologies for effective project planning and execution. Analyze business processes, systems, and data to identify improvement opportunities and create BRDs. Proficient in creating clear and comprehensive documentation. Understand and work on data models, process flows, and data mappings. Work closely with technical teams to design and validate solutions. Will learn skills like flow charts, detailed documentations such as BRD, FRD. Facilitate effective communication between business and technical teams. Familiarity with relevant project management tools, software tools and technologies. Maintain regular communication with project stakeholders, providing updates on progress, risks, and issues. Must track project timelines, milestones, and deliverables, ensuring projects stay on schedule. Present findings, progress updates, and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences. Define and execute test plans, collaborating to ensure high-quality solutions. Support project planning, estimation, and resource allocation, monitoring progress and identifying risks Skills MS office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)/ G suite, Figma proficiency. Experience in coding will be an added advantage. Possessing proficiency in multiple languages, both spoken and written, constitutes a valuable advantage. Candidates, who do not have any software education, please do not apply Strong knowledge of SDLC, Agile methodologies, and Jira/Confluence. Excellent communication and analytical skills. Proficiency in SQL, Excel, and BI tools (Power BI/Tableau). Strong problem-solving and critical thinking skills. Strong documentation and presentation skills. Experience with tools like AI studio, , Figma, MS Visio, Lucidchart, and project management platforms. title: Intern - Quality PTM
description: Job Summary** Valeo Management is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Quality PTM Intern to support our Quality team. This role offers a valuable opportunity to gain hands-on experience in quality management processes within a dynamic automotive supplier environment, focusing on Product Technical Management. Job Responsibilities** Assist in the implementation and monitoring of quality control plans and procedures. Support the analysis of quality data and identify trends and areas for improvement. Participate in the investigation and resolution of quality issues, including root cause analysis. Contribute to the preparation of quality documentation, reports, and presentations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., engineering, production, logistics) to ensure product quality throughout the lifecycle. Support the maintenance and improvement of quality management systems (e.g., IATF 16949). Assist in supplier quality management activities, including audits and performance monitoring. Learn and apply Valeo quality standards and methodologies. Perform other duties as assigned by the Quality PTM team. Job Qualifications** Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree program in Engineering (e.g., Mechanical, Industrial, Electrical), Quality Management, or a related technical field. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Detail-oriented with a strong commitment to quality. Knowledge of quality management principles and tools (e.g., FMEA, SPC, 8D) is a plus. Familiarity with automotive industry standards (e.g., IATF 16949) is an advantage.
